title: Plugin Manifest
description: Declares a content pack. Consumed by the v0.2 loader; used in v0.1 to describe plugins/core, which registers through the same public API it will (ADR-003 §6).

id.description: Namespace owned by this plugin. PERMANENT — every content ID and save key derives from it, so changing it orphans player data. Collisions are rejected at load.

name.description: Human-readable display name. May change freely.

version.description: Semantic version of this plugin, independent of the game version.

gameVersion.description: Semver range of game versions this plugin supports, e.g. ">=0.2.0 <0.4.0".

saveSchemaVersion.description: Version of this plugin's own save payload. Core never migrates plugin data — plugins version themselves (SAVE_FORMAT.md §8).

entry.description: Module exporting register(api). Relative to the plugin root.

dependencies.description: Other plugin IDs this one requires, mapped to semver ranges. Resolved by the v0.2 loader.

assets.description: Pre-built atlases shipped by this plugin. Plugin atlases are never repacked into core atlases (ASSETS.md §10).

manifest.description: Path to the plugin's generated asset manifest.
